title_zh: 为小型故事活动选房间并留出提问时间

scenario.label_zh: 为小型故事活动选房间并留出提问时间
scenario.goal_zh: 根据亲密交流的氛围选择小房间，并约定活动结束后保留二十分钟交流

context_zh: 两名活动组织者安排一位长期收藏老明信片的讲述者分享故事。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: Our speaker is a long-time collector of local postcards. The story about the missing bridge is especially intriguing.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Are we putting her in the main hall?

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: I'd prefer the reading room. There are only eighteen guests, and it would feel more intimate.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: That makes sense. People may want to linger afterwards and ask about their own postcards.

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: Can we keep the room for twenty minutes after the talk instead of clearing it straight away?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Yes, our booking allows that. I'll tell the room volunteer not to start packing up until then.

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: Great. Reading room, with twenty minutes for conversation at the end.

targets.sense_zh: 亲切私密的、便于近距离交流的
